snippet.title: Pepper the Giant Purple Dog - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3615340/Pepper_the_Giant_Purple_Dog/
In this twist on a harmless pet simulator, take care of Pepper, who happens to be a giant purple dog. You will be faced with such difficult tasks as: feeding, bathing, and walking Pepper. 

But the dog’s hunger will continue to grow and grow and grow, until you are forced to decide how far you are willing to go for man’s best friend.

The NPCs in the town of Normalville welcome you with open arms, and shortcomings aside, are great neighbors! Are you willing to do what needs to be done?

With multiple endings, and many routes to take, will you decide to take a pacifist approach? Or will you end up falling victim to the dog’s bidding? With coins to collect and the backend of the game to be peeled back, there is more than meets the eye.

Pepper the Giant Purple Dog is developed by the Silvercity Sharks (creators of Night of the Extinct, Greg’s Deadly Draft, and Wordfright) with art direction handled by Gerald Grabowski (co-creator of Night of the Extinct, artist for Garten of BanBan). 

Pepper the Giant Purple Dog releases in 2026 on Steam. Wishlist now!
